LocalDevelopment.title: ShiJing product UI is open in a protected development session
LocalDevelopment.detail: Persistence, Runtime AI, consultation, and presence verification are not admitted and remain explicitly fail-closed. The controls below verify one app-storage permission path only.
LocalDevelopment.permissionPurpose: Write one ShiJing local-development regression record to verify approval, revocation, and denial.
LocalDevelopment.writeSucceeded: Runtime confirmed the app-scoped JSON write.

Shell.protectedSessionTitle: ShiJing must be launched by Nimi Desktop
Shell.protectedSessionDetail: Launch ShiJing through the Desktop local-development supervisor. Account, permission, and Runtime state are projected only through the protected Kit/SDK carrier; there is no in-app sign-in or direct-connect fallback.
Shell.protectedSessionLocked: The ShiJing product area and all protected operations remain locked.

protectedAction.login-required: Sign in through Nimi Desktop, then relaunch ShiJing.
protectedAction.runtime-unavailable: Start the verified Runtime service from Nimi Desktop and retry.
protectedAction.permission-denied: Review the exact ShiJing permission in Nimi Desktop.
protectedAction.repair-required: Start a new local-development run from Nimi Desktop; do not launch the app shell directly.
protectedAction.capability-unavailable: Wait for the corresponding typed operation to receive admission. Direct gRPC and renderer credentials are not supported.
